text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, I ran confidently thanks to you,
Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! I saw! Your tenacious
running
brought a tear to my eye!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Two opposites drawn together, their rivalry pushing them to grow even stronger, and maybe even closer...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's giving me all the feels! OTP of the
Year, right
here!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I don't know what you're saying,
but I sense
you are showing reverence
toward your Overlord.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As a sign of my gratitude, I shall appoint
you an
honorary citizen of the Kingdom
of T.M. Opera!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm an honorary citizen? Of your
kingdom?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I couldn't possibly! This is more than I
can
handle!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-are you okay, Digital?! If you're not
feeling
well, I'll take you to the
infirmary!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: COUGH! And now you want to be my escort?! My oshis, you are too generous...
